summary: Resolved the quiesce/snapshot question with the activity rule. Every processed message is recorded into the quiesce state, resetting the idle clock and exiting quiesce, and hinted heartbeats count as read activity; entry into quiesce needs an idle interval of ten election timeouts. A live transfer's acknowledgements therefore keep the leader ticking and checkPendingSnapshotAck running, while a stall by definition means acks stopped and the cluster may quiesce, suspending the tick-driven backstop until the next processed message wakes the node and restarts leaderTick. Marked the investigation explained with defect_claim refuted, answered the gap as resolved, and recorded the activity rule; the residual idle-cluster dependence and resume latency are stated as limits. Source reasoning only.
